How every pathway protects you.

  • Broad choices only—no narrative intake or uploads.
  • No account, server submission, saved history or external AI.
  • Official and local sources are labeled and must be checked again before you rely on changing details.
  • Directory results are not rankings, referrals or endorsements.
  • Paid status cannot change facts, safety guidance or ordinary directory results.
  • Professional, eligibility and emergency decisions remain with the responsible organization or official office.
